title: Paralegal
description:
Managing Plaintiff's Personal Injury Paralegal

Our established and growing personal injury law firm is seeking an experienced Managing Paralegal to join our dynamic team in Astoria. This is a fantastic opportunity to grow your career in one of New York's largest and most respected PI firms, working in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

Position Overview:

We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented individual with a minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience in plaintiff's personal injury law. The ideal candidate will be capable of managing a full caseload independently from intake through trial preparation.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Handle all aspects of plaintiff's personal injury cases from inception to trial.
  • Independently draft legal documents including Notices of Claim, Summons and Complaints, Bills of Particulars, and Discovery responses.
  • Monitor and manage statutes of limitations and critical deadlines.
  • Oversee a caseload of approximately 120 active files.
  • Ensure compliance with litigation procedures and Court Orders.
  • Coordinate with attorneys, clients, and medical providers as needed.

Qualifications:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in plaintiff's personal injury litigation.
  • Strong drafting skills and a comprehensive understanding of PI litigation processes.
  • Must be able to read medical records
  • Excellent organizational and case management skills.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and thrive under pressure.
  • Must be seeking a long-term role with room for growth.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary (commensurate with experience)
  • Full benefits package
  • Friendly and supportive team environment
  • Immediate hire for the right candidate

If you're ready to take the next step in your legal career, we want to hear from you. Please submit your resume along with your salary requirements for immediate consideration.

Job Type: Full-time

Benefits:

  • 401(k)
  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Opportunities for advancement
  • Paid time off
  • Parental leave
  • Vision insurance

Experience:

  • Plaintiffs PI: 3 years (Required)

License/Certification:

  • Certified Notary Public (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Assistant Controller
description:
One of largest on-the-go news and entertainment network in North America is seeking an Assistant Controller.

Position Summary:

The Assistant Controller will serve as a key leader within the Finance organization, reporting to the Controller, VP Finance. The Asst Controller will be expected to be the right hand to the Controller, VP Finance and to take ownership of the company's accounting operations and to ensure the delivery of timely, accurate, and compliant financial information. This role will be hands-on in managing the monthly and annual close processes, supporting yearly external audits, and ensuring adherence to GAAP and internal control standards. The Assistant Controller will be a trusted partner to the Controller, VP Finance, providing insight, driving process efficiencies, and implementing best practices to support Captivate's continued growth and operational excellence.

This position requires a proven leader who can effectively manage and mentor a team, foster a high-performance culture, and confidently navigate complex accounting matters. The ideal candidate will have deep technical accounting expertise, strong NetSuite experience, and a track record of successfully leading close and audit cycles in fast-paced, evolving environments. Prior experience in an audit firm is highly valued, as it will enable this leader to bring a disciplined, detail-oriented approach to compliance, reporting, and process improvement.

The Assistant Controller will play a critical role in scaling the accounting function, documenting processes, improving systems and workflows, and building the financial infrastructure needed to support both current operations and future growth. This is an opportunity to join a collaborative Finance team and to make a meaningful impact at a growing company.

ANNUAL SALARY: $150,000-$160,000

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close process, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to GAAP.
  • Oversee and mentor accounting staff, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and professional development.
  • Support the audit process from start to finish, serving as the primary support for the Controller, VP Finance with external auditors and ensuring all schedules and supporting documentation are prepared accurately and on time.
  • Leverage NetSuite expertise to optimize workflows, improve reporting accuracy, and enhance system utilization across the accounting function.
  • Review and approve journal entries, account reconciliations, and variance analyses prepared by the team.
  • With the Controller, VP of Finance, own the accuracy of the general ledger and ensure appropriate classification of transactions.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain robust internal controls to safeguard company assets and ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with FP&A, operations, and other departments to ensure accurate financial data and provide insights for decision-making.
  • Drive process improvement initiatives, including automation, system enhancements, and streamlined reporting tools to improve efficiency.
  • Monitor and analyze accounting processes, recommending policy or procedural changes when needed.
  • Serve as a key financial liaison for internal stakeholders, translating complex accounting matters into clear, actionable information for leadership.

Qualifications:

  • Education & Certification: CPA required.
  • Experience: 5–10 years of progressive accounting experience, including supervisory responsibilities.
  • Required - Strong NetSuite expertise with a proven track record of optimizing system capabilities.
  • Required - Demonstrated experience running and leading a close process within a set timetable.
  • Prior audit firm experience (public accounting background preferred).
  • In-depth knowledge of GAAP, internal controls, and financial reporting.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to manage, mentor, and develop a team.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • High attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to work under tight deadlines.

title: ServiceNow Configuration Manager
description:
ServiceNow Configuration Manager
Full Time
Jersey City, NJ (Hybrid)

Job Summary:

The ServiceNow Configuration Manager will be responsible for the governance, maintenance, and continual improvement of the Configuration Management Database (CMDB) within our ServiceNow platform. This role is crucial for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of our configuration data, which underpins critical IT Service Management (ITSM) processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Asset Management. A key focus of this position will be the implementation and adherence to the ServiceNow Common Service Data Model (CSDM) to establish a clear and consistent service-oriented view of our IT landscape.

Responsibilities:

CMDB Governance and Management:
  • Serve as the primary owner and subject matter expert for the ServiceNow CMDB.
  • Develop, implement, and enforce CMDB policies, standards, and procedures to ensure data quality and integrity.
  • Define and manage the CMDB data model, including CI classes, attributes, and relationships, in alignment with CSDM.
  • Oversee the CI lifecycle management process, from creation and discovery to retirement.
  • Conduct regular audits and data quality checks to identify and resolve discrepancies.
  • Monitor and manage integrations with discovery tools (e.g., ServiceNow Discovery, SCCM) and other data sources to maintain an accurate CMDB.
CSDM Implementation and Adherence:
  • Lead the implementation and ongoing maturation of the ServiceNow Common Service Data Model (CSDM).
  • Work with stakeholders to define and map business services, technical services, and application services to their underlying CIs.
  • Ensure that the CMDB effectively supports CSDM principles and provides a clear and consistent view of our service portfolio.
  • Champion the adoption of CSDM across IT teams to improve service management processes and reporting.
Stakeholder Collaboration:
  • Collaborate with Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, and other process owners to ensure the CMDB effectively supports their activities and reporting needs.
  • Provide training and guidance to IT staff on CMDB processes, policies, and best practices.
  • Work with application owners and infrastructure teams to ensure CIs and their relationships are accurately represented in the CMDB.
Reporting and Analytics:
  • Develop and maintain CMDB-related dashboards and reports to monitor data health and provide actionable insights.
  • Generate regular reports on CMDB metrics, including data completeness, accuracy, and compliance with established standards.

Qualifications & Skills:

Education:
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related experience.

Experience:
  • 5+ years of experience in IT Service Management, with a minimum of 3 years focused on Configuration Management.
  • Proven hands-on experience as a ServiceNow Administrator, Developer, or similar role.
  • Deep understanding and practical experience with the ServiceNow Common Service Data Model (CSDM).
  • Expertise in configuring and managing the ServiceNow CMDB module.
  • Experience with ServiceNow Discovery and other data population methods.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Knowledge of the ServiceNow platform architecture, capabilities, and best practices.
  • Experience working in an Agile development environment (Scrum/Kanban) is a plus.
Soft Skills:
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and concisely to diverse audiences.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, capable of breaking down complex issues into manageable components.
  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to build relationships and influence outcomes.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities and projects simultaneously.
  • Proactive and self-motivated with a strong commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
Certifications (Preferred):
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
  • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) for any ServiceNow module.

4 year college degree preferred.
